english:
Taking damage from Combatants has a 20% chance to spawn a <strand Threadling />, and reaching Critical Health spawns one.

Each trigger has its own 5 second cooldown between <strand Threadling /> spawns.

source.text:
2 Piece | Sinew Stitching

Upon reaching Critical Health, or with a 20% chance every time Combatant Damage is taken:
Spawns a Threadling.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Threadling spawns from damage and a 5 second cooldown between Threadlings spawns from reaching Critical Health.
